K9824d14d.detail: Every IV spec this method builds reaches only decryptions, and commons/src/androidMain/kotlin/com/vitorpamplona/amethyst/commons/model/preferences/SecretEncryption.android.kt encrypts with Cipher.init(ENCRYPT_MODE, key) and no parameter spec, then keeps the IV the cipher returns: the provider generated that IV from its own random source, and the IV reaching the spec is that one, read back for decryption. What the detector's report means: NOT OBSERVED: the runtime monitor tracks the producers a rule requires by object identity within one process, and saw none for this object. No admitted producer was seen (e.g. SecureRandom for an IV, salt or seed; Key.getEncoded() for key bytes). The monitor cannot tell innocent cases -- bytes read back from storage, an IV parsed from the ciphertext, a producer it does not see -- from the defective one: bytes that are constants compiled into the application or derived from constants. Where the bytes come from decides it.
